case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-J1.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
sup:DEMO-J1.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quick and clear offer for the SH-220 shaft. We appreciate your practical approach and would like to work with you on this part.

To be transparent, we have a competing offer on the table:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

To award the order to you, we need to close that gap. We have set out three genuine options below. Option C keeps your usual payment terms if quick payment matters to you.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.69; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.03; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Please let us know which option works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your prompt and friendly offer for the SH-220 stainless shaft. We appreciate your interest in a long-term partnership and would like to make this work.

Your proposal is a good starting point, but it is not yet where we need it to be to award the position. We have prepared three options for you to consider:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.15; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.74; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option B keeps your current payment term. Option A gives you a longer payment term in exchange. In all three options we take delivery DAP.

We look forward to hearing which option suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, thanks for being open about the other offer. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

As a small shop, we really need to stick to our 30-day payment terms, so we have to build on Option C. We can include DAP delivery and drop the price to €15.70, which is a big step from our side to make this work. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our full Angebot stands at a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for checking the competing quote so openly and for the significant step you have taken. We appreciate it, and we would still like to award the SH-220 to you.

We understand that keeping your usual payment terms matters to a small shop, and we have built on that. Option C keeps your standard payment terms with DAP delivery, and it only needs a modest further move on price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.76; payment 14 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 15.20; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.10; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

If one of these works for you, we can move ahead with the award promptly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to build on your Option C, accepting the 35-day lead time and DAP delivery to support your requirements. Please note that DAP delivery and a shorter lead time incur substantial freight and expediting costs compared to our initial EXW offer. To accommodate your preferred terms, we have adjusted our base price and can offer €16.80 per unit for this package. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

Under this offer, we provide a price of €16.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. This quote remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
